cohort: Two female patients (aged 18 and 71) with high-grade ulcerated soft tissue sarcomas in the gluteal region treated with extended external hemipelvectomies.
finding: External hemipelvectomy for soft tissue sarcoma treatment is a demanding surgical procedure with purpose in selected cases after review by multidisciplinary committees and with informed patient consent.
mod_finding: One patient (case 1) had an uncomplicated pregnancy and a cesarean section delivery after treatment.
